payload.text: utilz menuz build and test pass five stamps as build settings: MENUZ_COMMIT is git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD, and MENUZ_KIND is release or dev by the rule help/menuz.md states with the stamps (since ST0031/03); Info.plist carries MenuzKind and project.yml defaults it to dev; stamps prints the five lines in a clone and reads MenuzKind from the installed bundle in a Homebrew install; status prints the eight-character commit; menuz.bats covers each answer of the kind against a fixture repository, and bats is green on kovacs.
